binance.title: Binance Will Support the Broadcom (AVGO), Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ), Meta (META), and Seagate (STX) Cash Dividend Distribution via bStocks

Published: 2026-09-18T05:00:10.872Z

This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. bStocks are offered through an Approved Prospectus in the ADGM and are not offered in any other jurisdiction. bStocks are Tokenized securities issued by BTech Holding Limited, a Binance group affiliate. bStocks are classified as Certificates representing certain Financial Instruments (paragraph 92, Schedule 1 to FSMR). bStocks represent an interest in underlying securities held by the Issuer and are not direct ownership of the underlying Shares. bStocks do not allow holders to directly own a share or stock in the underlying listed company. Fellow Binancians, Binance will support the Broadcom (AVGO) , Invesco QQQ Trust（QQQ), Meta (META), and Seagate (STX) cash dividend distribution via bStocks for AVGOB, QQQB, METAB, and STXB holders. Net amount of the cash dividend will be reinvested after applicable withholding taxes, fees, costs, and other deductions, into additional units or fractions of the same underlying security. Eligible users will receive dividends in the form of AVGOB, QQQB, METAB, and STXB bStocks respectively. On-chain holders of AVGOB, QQQB, METAB, and STXB will receive the bStock dividends through a multiplier adjustment. Eligibility: Users with AVGOB, QQQB, and METAB holdings on the record date snapshot at 2026-09-21 00:00 (UTC) will be eligible for the dividend distribution. Users with STXB holdings on the record date snapshot at 2026-09-24 00:00 (UTC) will be eligible for the dividend distribution. General: Trading of AVGOB/USDT, QQQB/USDT, METAB/USDT, STXB/USDT will not be affected. AVGOB, QQQB and METAB  At 2026-09-18 23:30 (UTC), the token conversion service for 1:1 swaps between AVGO/AVGOB, QQQ/QQQB, and META/METAB will be suspended. At 2026-09-20 23:30 (UTC), deposits and withdrawals of AVGOB, QQQB, and METAB tokens will be suspended. Users should ensure they leave sufficient time for their AVGOB, QQQB, and METAB token deposits to be fully processed prior to this time. STXB  At 2026-09-23 23:30 (UTC), the token conversion service for 1:1 swaps between STX stock and STXB bStocks will be suspended. At 2026-09-23 23:30 (UTC), deposits and withdrawals of STX will be suspended. Users should ensure they leave sufficient time for their STXB deposits to be fully processed prior to this time.  Deposits, withdrawals, and token conversion service for AVGOB, QQQB, METAB, and STXB will resume when the distribution is completed. No further announcement will be posted. Users can also subscribe to the recovery notification where available. Dividends earned from assets held in other accounts will be credited to Spot Account, including but not limited to Savings Account, Margin Account, etc. Binance will handle all technical requirements for users who are involved in this event. Reinvestment and distribution of dividends is after deduction of withholding tax. Users may refer to the announcements from the companies for more information. For more information about bStocks dividend distribution, please refer to the FAQ. Convert: Binance Convert will pause the conversion of AVGOB, QQQB, and METAB and all associated pairs at 2026-09-20 23:30 (UTC). Binance Convert will pause the conversion of STXB and all associated pairs at 2026-09-23 23:30 (UTC).
